To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of graphical and formal methods can be supported by a tool that automatically generate a secure access control system.
we have developed a prototype tool to generate B specifications from a graphical representation of an information system and a set of security rules.
the combination of graphical and formal notation is a good way to model information systems and their secure access control filter.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and the validation of secure access control filters in the context of the development of information systems using the UML language and the B formal method.
the automatic generation of formal specifications from UML class diagrams and UML activity models.
the design and the implementation of a tool that permits to generate a formal secure access filter for information systems from a set of graphical models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this tool is a valuable asset in the design of secure access control filters.
the tool is a valuable contribution for the design of a formal filter.
the proposed approach and its implementation in a tool are promising and can be used in the future to support the design and the implementation of secure access control systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it proposes a formal framework for the generation of secure access control filters for information systems.
the tool provides a graphical interface for the user, who can draw the diagrams and the filter using a UML CASE tool, and then, it generates the B specification and the corresponding code.
the tool provides the user with an efficient way to design a secure filter for an information system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tool can be easily adapted to other formalisms and graphical notations.
we provide a tool that automatically translates the UML diagrams into a B specification, which is then used as a basis to automatically generate the filter.
the use of a formal method in the development process of a filter permits to guarantee its correctness and security.
